name: EmmyLuaDebug
cmd:
--连接EmmyLua
local function split(line, sep, maxsplit)
    if string.len(line) == 0 then
        return {}
    end
    sep = sep or " "
    maxsplit = maxsplit or 0
    local retval = {}
    local pos = 1
    local step = 0
    while true do
        local from, to = string.find(line, sep, pos, true)
        step = step + 1
        if (maxsplit ~= 0 and step > maxsplit) or not from then
            local item = string.sub(line, pos)
            table.insert(retval, item)
            break
        else
            local item = string.sub(line, pos, from - 1)
            table.insert(retval, item)
            pos = to + 1
        end
    end
    return retval
end

local function connectEmmyLua()
    local func = function()
        local assets = CS.UnityEngine.Application.dataPath
        local assetDict = split(assets, "/")
        local path = ''
        for i = 1, #assetDict-1 do
            path = path .. assetDict[i] .. '/'
        end
        package.cpath = package.cpath .. ';' .. path .. 'Tools/EmmyLua/emmy_core.dll'
        local dbg = require('emmy_core')
        dbg.tcpConnect('localhost', 12580)
    end

    local handle = function(error)
        print('hyx IDE没有开启调试', error)
    end

    xpcall(func, handle)
end
connectEmmyLua()
--连接EmmyLua

name: 打印Hierarchy结构
cmd:
local Scene = CS.UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager
local lines = {}
local function traverse(tf, depth)
    local indent = string.rep("  ", depth)
    local go = tf.gameObject
    local tag = ""
    if not go.activeSelf then
        tag = " [inactive]"
    end
    local childCount = tf.childCount
    local comp = ""
    if childCount > 0 then
        comp = " (" .. childCount .. ")"
    end
    table.insert(lines, indent .. tf.name .. comp .. tag)
    for i = 0, childCount - 1 do
        traverse(tf:GetChild(i), depth + 1)
    end
end
local sceneCount = Scene.sceneCount
for s = 0, sceneCount - 1 do
    local scene = Scene.GetSceneAt(s)
    table.insert(lines, "===== Scene: " .. scene.name .. " =====")
    local roots = scene:GetRootGameObjects()
    for i = 0, roots.Length - 1 do
        traverse(roots[i].transform, 0)
    end
end
print(table.concat(lines, "\n"))

name: 开启/关闭 lua-control
cmd:
-- 开启/关闭 lua-control (Toggle)
if _G.LuaControlClient and _G.LuaControlClient.IsRunning then
    _G.LuaControlClient.Stop()
else
    local C = {}
    C.Socket = nil
    C.Host = "localhost"
    C.Port = 9530
    C.IsRunning = false
    C.ReconnectTimer = 0
    C.HeartbeatTimer = 0

    local ok_sock, socket_lib = pcall(require, "socket.core")
    if not ok_sock or not socket_lib then
        print("[LuaControl] socket.core 加载失败")
        return
    end

    local function je(val)
        local t = type(val)
        if t == "string" then
            return '"' .. val:gsub('\\','\\\\'):gsub('"','\\"'):gsub('\n','\\n'):gsub('\r','\\r'):gsub('\t','\\t') .. '"'
        elseif t == "number" then return tostring(val)
        elseif t == "boolean" then return val and "true" or "false"
        elseif t == "nil" then return "null"
        elseif t == "table" then
            local parts = {}
            if #val > 0 then
                for _, v in ipairs(val) do parts[#parts+1] = je(v) end
                return "[" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "]"
            else
                for k, v in pairs(val) do parts[#parts+1] = '"' .. tostring(k) .. '":' .. je(v) end
                return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "}"
            end
        end
        return "null"
    end

    local function jd(str)
        local ok, j = pcall(require, "XCommon/Json")
        if ok and j and j.decode then
            local ok2, r = pcall(j.decode, str)
            if ok2 then return r end
        end
        local r = {}
        for k, v in str:gmatch('"([^"]+)"%s*:%s*"?([^,}]+)"?') do
            if v == "true" then v = true
            elseif v == "false" then v = false
            elseif tonumber(v) then v = tonumber(v)
            else v = v:gsub('^"',''):gsub('"$','') end
            r[k] = v
        end
        return r
    end

    function C.Send(data)
        if not C.Socket then return end
        local ok, pkt = pcall(je, data)
        if not ok then return end
        local sendOk, sendErr = pcall(function()
            C.Socket:settimeout(0.05)
            C.Socket:send(pkt .. "\n")
        end)
        if not sendOk then
            local errStr = tostring(sendErr)
            if errStr:find("closed") or errStr:find("refused") or errStr:find("reset") then
                C.Close()
            end
        end
    end

    function C.SendLog(level, msg, refId)
        C.Send({ type = "LOG", level = level, msg = msg, ref_id = refId })
    end

    function C.Connect()
        if C.Socket then return end
        local tcp = socket_lib.tcp()
        tcp:settimeout(0.5)
        local res, err = tcp:connect(C.Host, C.Port)
        if res then
            tcp:settimeout(0)
            C.Socket = tcp
            local info = { platform = "Unknown", device = "Unknown", pid = 0 }
            pcall(function()
                info.platform = CS.UnityEngine.Application.platform:ToString()
                info.device = CS.UnityEngine.SystemInfo.deviceModel
                info.pid = CS.System.Diagnostics.Process.GetCurrentProcess().Id
            end)
            C.Send({ type = "HELLO", pid = info.pid, device = info.device, platform = info.platform })
            print("[LuaControl] 已连接 " .. C.Host .. ":" .. C.Port)
        else
            tcp:close()
        end
    end

    function C.Close()
        if C.Socket then pcall(function() C.Socket:close() end) C.Socket = nil end
    end

    function C.ProcessPacket(line)
        local pkt = jd(line)
        if not pkt then return end
        if pkt.type == "EXEC" then
            local loader = rawget(_G, "loadstring") or load
            local fn, loadErr = loader(pkt.cmd)
            if not fn then
                C.SendLog("error", "Load Error: " .. tostring(loadErr), pkt.id)
                return
            end
            local ok, execErr = pcall(fn)
            if not ok then
                C.SendLog("error", "Runtime Error: " .. tostring(execErr), pkt.id)
            else
                C.SendLog("info", "Success", pkt.id)
            end
        end
    end

    function C.Update()
        if not C.IsRunning then return end
        local now = 0
        pcall(function() now = CS.UnityEngine.Time.realtimeSinceStartup end)
        if not C.Socket then
            if now - C.ReconnectTimer > 3 then
                C.ReconnectTimer = now
                C.Connect()
            end
            return
        end
        if now - C.HeartbeatTimer > 15 then
            C.HeartbeatTimer = now
            C.Send({ type = "PING" })
        end
        for i = 1, 5 do
            local ok, result = pcall(function()
                C.Socket:settimeout(0)
                local line, err, partial = C.Socket:receive("*l")
                return { line = line, err = err, partial = partial }
            end)
            if not ok then C.Close() return end
            local line = result.line
            if not line and result.partial and #result.partial > 0 then line = result.partial end
            if not line then
                if result.err == "closed" then C.Close() return end
                break
            end
            C.ProcessPacket(line)
        end
    end

    function C.Stop()
        C.IsRunning = false
        C.Close()
        local go = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Find("LuaControlUpdater")
        if go then CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(go) end
        rawset(_G, "LuaControlClient", nil)
        print("[LuaControl] 已关闭")
    end

    C.IsRunning = true
    local goName = "LuaControlUpdater"
    local go = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Find(goName)
    if not go then
        go = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject(goName)
        CS.UnityEngine.Object.DontDestroyOnLoad(go)
    end
    local b = go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.XLuaBehaviour))
    if not b then b = go:AddComponent(typeof(CS.XLuaBehaviour)) end
    b.LuaUpdate = function() C.Update() end
    rawset(_G, "LuaControlClient", C)
    print("[LuaControl] 已开启，等待 bridge 连接 localhost:9530")
end
